summary: Medallion Financial Corp. filed an 8-K announcing preliminary results from its 2026 annual meeting. The activist ZimCal Asset Management LLC sought to replace three director nominees, but shareholders re-elected the company's slate with approximately 78% of votes cast (activist nominees received ~19%, down from ~22% in 2024). This marks ZimCal's third consecutive defeated proxy contest. No deal terms were provided. Watch for potential ongoing activist pressure or board-level engagement given repeated campaigns.
